name: APS Sector 1, beamline 1-ID (MPE)
distances: z_m = distance from the source along the beam (m); z_conf/z_src give provenance. Known so far (2026-11-11): the source (0) and the lens stacks in B/C/E and the default sample position in E, all from mpe_bluesky (~0.1 m resolution). Everything else is null (not guessed).
beam_direction: left to right on every operator panel (CS-Studio); hutch order downstream is SRC > A > B > C > E

hutches.SRC: Source: undulator and front end (not photographed)
hutches.A: First optics hutch: white-beam slits, A (front-end) shutter, HEM monochromator (not photographed; from code + earlier user notes)
hutches.B: Mono-beam hutch: ICs, CRLs, HRM, foil/attenuator, lens stacks, B fast shutter, Cork, Kohzu slit, B-TOM tomo stage
hutches.C: Beam-conditioning (ICs, slit, lens stacks L1-L6, attenuator, slit 2) then LabMotion sample stage, DBA, Tomo D1, stop, Varex D2, Lens7
hutches.E: Beam-conditioning (IC1+2, slit US, FS, Lens1-4, slit DS) then Aero SMS sample stage, Tomo D1, NF D2, D3, Hydra D4, VFF D5, Radiograph, SAXS D6

frame.x: horizontal. Looking downstream +x points LEFT (hardware-confirmed 2026-10-28 on samE: +x moves the pin image left). Drawn on the Aero_SMS/Aero_Trans panels as +X into the screen with +Z to the right and +Y up (right-handed).
frame.omega: samE.ry (1ide:m9): left-handed stage, +omega is clockwise seen from above (BLADE ROT_SIGN=+1)

snapshot.note: Operator-screen values at photo time. They are a snapshot of one state, NOT defaults or targets.
snapshot.panel_header_unlabelled_note: 'Delivered Beam 200.1 mA 10.012 mm 71.676 keV'; the mm value has no label on the panel. With the 2026-11-12 screenshots it is very probably the undulator gap: the C/E headers read [S:DesiredMode] [shutters mode] [S:ActualMode] [S-DCCT:C = ring current] [S01ID:DSI.. = value in mm] [1id:us.. = keV], and the ID Gap Control panel (cs06) uses the prefix S01ID:DSID: (still truncated, so not verified).
snapshot.fast_shutters: FS_B indicator dark, FS_E indicator bright green (open/closed colour convention not confirmed)
snapshot.note_2026-11-12: The CS-Studio screenshots cs03/cs04 show NO values (PVs disconnected, magenta dotted fields; station boxes show 'Closed' over 'OPEN'); the readings above therefore still come from the phone photos p13/p14.

header_pvs.note: Header strip of the C and E panels (cs03, cs04), left to right; PV names are truncated on screen
header_pvs.also: bottom of the C and E panels: A/B/C/E-Station shutter boxes and 'Fast-Shutter Status' FS_B / FS_E circles

beam_types.white: source > Filter > WB slits > HEM crystals (hutch A upstream of the HEM; dark red line on the overview cs01)
beam_types.monochromatic: after the HEM through B, C and E (light red line on cs01)

ic_readout.note: Resolved 2026-11-13 from the CS-Studio layout displays (1idb/1idc/1ide_layout.bob: each IC button opens an SR570 panel with preamp A<n> and scaler channel N); full table in cs_registry.json (elements.<icXX>.devices[].ic). Channel number = scaler field S<N>.

E.note: IC1+2 (one box) has no read-out button on the E display, only the SIC1_Y motor 1ide1:m19; no IC7 in E

operator_screens.note: CS-Studio tabs visible on the beamline workstation (p12-p18). 2026-11-12: screenshots (cs01-cs06) now cover the 1-ID-Main overview (cs01), B, C, E panels (cs02-cs04), 1-ID IOC Control tab Detector(E) (cs05) and the W_Beam / ID Gap Control / userTran3 / HEM motor screens (cs06). Phone photos still hold the readings: All Slits (p15), Aero_SMS (p16), SAXS_D6 (p17), Aero_Trans (p18). The user confirmed the overview strip is all there is of 1-ID-Main and that B ends at the magenta circle. 2026-11-12 (later): C screens fourC table/circle (cs07, cs08), LabMotion_SMS (cs09), DBA (cs13); IOC Control tabs Detector(B/C), VME Crate, Misc (cs10-cs12); Tomo_E (cs14). Overview buttons cannot be expanded from the main screen. NOT captured: IOC Control tab Qserver.

overview_cs01.note: Buttons that open the hutch screens. 'Table' (B, C) and 'Mot' (all hutches) panels, and the 1ide / 1ide1 motor-IOC panels, were not captured.

workstation_viewers.note: Image windows open on the workstation (p11-p18), shown only as titles

detector_iocs.note: '1-ID IOC Control' tab Detector(E) (cs05) and Detector(B/C) (cs10). Assignments marked 'user' were given by the user 2026-11-12; cs05 itself only lists the IOCs. Rule (user 2026-11-13): where an assignment is in doubt it is left open ('element': null, candidates listed), never guessed.

coverage.A: 1-ID-Main overview strip (cs01) + WB slit / HEM / ID gap panels (cs06) + user (A shutter first) + code
coverage.B: CS-Studio panel screenshot (cs02; order, no live values; complete) + phone photo for readings + code
coverage.C: CS-Studio panel (cs03) + fourC table/circle motors (cs07, cs08) + LabMotion_SMS (cs09) + DBA control (cs13) + phone photo for readings + slit table + code; no hutch photos
coverage.E: CS-Studio panel screenshot (cs04) + IOC Control (cs05) + Tomo_E screen (cs14) + hutch photos (sample stack, lens stacks, tomo stage, monitor) + motor panels + code

ioc_panels.note: All tabs of '1-ID IOC Control' (last update 2024-09-25), rows with RUN/STOP/Status/Display. Support systems, not beam elements.
ioc_panels.meaning: VME crates = the motor IOC prefixes 1ida, 1idb, 1idc, 1ide, 1ide1 (these are what the overview buttons 1ide / 1ide1 open); HEM_Z2 and PI518 (HRM) are the HEM and HRM support IOCs.

assignment_rule: User rule 2026-11-13: never assign a PV, motor, camera or device to an element on a guess; leave it open and list candidates in notes. Only user statements, code (mpe_bluesky) or full-legible panel labels assign.

station_shutters.note: Status boxes A/B/C/E-Station at the bottom of every hutch panel; the control panel pairs Open/Close buttons with FES, SBS, SCS under A, B, C. E-Station (SES) has status only and is the fourth PV of the status list (by elimination).

cs_displays.note: Machine-readable record of the operator displays: cs_registry.json (made by beamline_twins/tools/csdisplays.py extract from the display folder configured as 'cs_displays', see blade/paths.py). `csdisplays.py check` and tests/test_cs_registry.py compare the twin and the s1id profile with it. Display dates: 1-ID-Main 07-20-2026, C layout 8-31-2026, E layout 03-04-2026 (printed on the screens; B has none).
